name: Askitari Girls Growth Potions
source: Natalie recently moved to a new city, where she works at a small pharmacy. Gradually, she's getting used to her new life... but it doesn't take long before a series of events make her contemplate creating a new kind of magical formulas. It's time to brew potions to enhance her muscles!
translation: 娜塔莉最近搬到了一个新城市，她在一家小药房工作。渐渐地，她开始习惯新的生活……但没过多久，一系列事件就让她开始考虑创造一种新的魔法配方。是时候酿造药剂来增强她的肌肉了！
